

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let mut rounds = 0;



'outer: 




loop {
    

let body_local = rounds;




rounds = rounds + 1;



'inner: 



for item in 0..3 {
    

let nested_local = item;




if nested_local == 0 { continue 'inner; }




if body_local == 0 { continue 'outer; }




print!("nested body once {}", nested_local);




break 'outer;



}







break 'outer;



}







let body_local = "outside";




print!("after {}", body_local);



    
}
